advisor_identified: Timothy E. Anna, historian of Latin America in the University of Manitoba History Department from 1969; later Distinguished Professor Emeritus.

doctorate.title: Mexico City in the War of Independence, 1810-1821

evidence.says: University of Manitoba Archives, Timothy Anna fonds (MSS 342), biographical sketch, p. 3: Anna obtained his PhD at Duke University in 1969 and joined Manitoba’s History Department as a Latin America specialist that fall; became Distinguished Professor Emeritus in 2010. Read through the search index; direct retrieval returned HTTP 403.

Teresa Lozano Armendares, La criminalidad en la ciudad de México, 1800-1821, bibliography, p. 361: lists Timothy E. Anna’s Mexico City in the War of Independence, 1810-1821 and explicitly identifies it as a Duke University PhD thesis, 1969; the microfilm reproduction is dated 1979.

notes: The advisor’s institution, degree year and dissertation title match the linked AHA record. Its abbreviated terminal year, 1810-21, is equivalent to 1810-1821 in the bibliography.
